The integration of these pathways implies that Mesquitol may modulate the activity of cemiplimab-rwlc, potentially influencing the interaction between the CD276 antigen and its target. The evidence suggests a possible regulatory or inhibitory role for Mesquitol in the context of this immune checkpoint pathway, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The relationship is supported by a chain of targets, highlighting a possible functional link between Mesquitol and CD276 antigen through the cemiplimab-rwlc protein.
